title: [Fabric] Fix installation with an existing upgrade tag
summary: Fabric installation now guards the database upgrade tag insert to prevent duplicate-key errors when the tag already exists from company initialization, while keeping log-table initialization unconditional.
key_points: Prevents duplicate-key error during Fabric installation when upgrade tag already registered
Guards tag insert with HasDatabaseUpgradeTag check
Preserves unconditional log-table initialization on every install
No impact on existing database-upgrade paths
No API, schema, or permission changes
quote: Guard the insert with `HasDatabaseUpgradeTag` while keeping required log-table initialization unconditional.
